correctness.rationale: Reconstructed from actual RESULT.md: stable-set polytope is coordinatewise downward-closed by thinning random independent sets. With q=(1+r)c, containment −(P−c)⊂r(P−c) means q−x∈rP for all x∈P; x=0 and x=e_i force q∈rP and q_i≥1, and downward closure proves converse. Fractional coloring gives minimum r=χ_f and q=1 feasible. Compact dual D=nonnegative weights with independent-set sums ≤1; antiblocker representation λP={z≥0:y·z≤λ ∀y∈D}. At optimum y, y·q≤λ=∑y with q≥1 forces pinned q_i=1 on optimal support. For vertices outside T, every dual vertex with y_i>0 has strict objective gap; finitely many vertices allow a small positive box in those directions, giving affine dimension n−|T|. Perfect-graph specialization uses clique polytope description; automorphism averaging gives transitive uniqueness. Independent LP finite cases and provided exact-rational verifier support examples only.
residual_risks: Proof relies on standard antiblocking equivalence and finite fractional LP duality.
